mutant.lineText: const tag = (name: string, text: string | undefined, attrs?: Record<string, string>) => (text === undefined ? '' : `<${name}${attrString(attrs)}>${escapeText(text)}</${name}>`);
mutant.nextText: const attrString = (a?: Record<string, string | undefined>) => (a ? Object.entries(a).filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined).map(([k, v]) => ` ${k}="${escapeAttr(v!)}"`).join('') : '');
